title: factdiff.py close re-points the path:line citations to the lines its inserted bullet shifted, in the ledgers and other articles
goal: factdiff.py close maps the lines its inserted bullet shifts and rewrites every path:line citation of that article in _answers.md, _gaps.md, _conflicts.md, _sources.csv and other articles, so each citation still names the same fact

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbroot
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
d = os.path.join(t, "zq")
sid = "ZQ-abcdefgh"
art = ["---", "topic: win/a", "priority: P1", "applies_to: x", "retrieved_utc: 2026-01-01", "sources: [" + sid + "]", "status: complete", "---", "", "# A", "",
       "## Summary", "- Summary line one. [DOC " + sid + "]", "", "## Facts", "- First fact holds. [DOC " + sid + "]", "- Second fact holds. [DOC " + sid + "]", "- Third fact holds. [DOC " + sid + "]", ""]
other = ["---", "topic: win/b", "priority: P1", "applies_to: x", "retrieved_utc: 2026-01-01", "sources: [" + sid + "]", "status: complete", "---", "", "# B", "",
         "## Summary", "- Summary line one. [DOC " + sid + "]", "", "## Facts", "- B repeats the third fact of A (`win/a.md:18`). [DOC " + sid + "]", ""]
files = {"_root.md": kbroot.root_md("zq", "ZQ", "internal", "planted"), **{k: v.format(name="zq") for k, v in kbroot.FILES.items()},
         "win/a.md": "\n".join(art), "win/b.md": "\n".join(other)}
files["_sources.csv"] += sid + ",https://example.org/a,A,P,CC BY 4.0,copy,2026-01-01,confirmed; a.md:18 holds,,win/a.md;win/b.md,\n"
files["_answers.md"] += "\n## QK-plant. What does the second fact say?\n- It holds. (`win/a.md:17`) [DOC " + sid + "]\n"
files["_gaps.md"] += "\n## Gap\n  - Tried 2026-02-01: see `win/a.md:18` (topic: win/a)\n"
files["_conflicts.md"] += "\n## Conflict\n  - Read `win/a.md:17` against the page (topic: win/a)\n"
for rel, text in files.items():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, rel)) or d, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, rel), "w").write(text)
env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=d)
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/factdiff.py", "--root", "zq", "close", "win/a.md:16", "--on", "2026-06-01", "--from", "2026-01-01",
                    "--text", "First fact now differs. [DOC " + sid + "]"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
rd = lambda p: open(os.path.join(d, p)).read()
want = [("_answers.md", "win/a.md:18"), ("_gaps.md", "win/a.md:19"), ("_conflicts.md", "win/a.md:18"), ("win/b.md", "win/a.md:19"), ("_sources.csv", "a.md:19")]
bad = [f"{p} lacks {w}" for p, w in want if w not in rd(p)]
print("close exit", r.returncode, "; citations not re-pointed:", bad)
sys.exit(1 if r.returncode or bad else 0)

clauses.clause: factdiff.py close maps the lines its inserted bullet shifts and rewrites every path:line citation of that article in _answers.md, _gaps.md, _conflicts.md, _sources.csv and other articles, so each citation still names the same fact

notes: Found 2026-11-09 when a refresh run re-pointed 24 citations with a scratch diff-based script; any other tool that inserts a fact line is a later story. Premise: the planted-root check exits 1 on 55dde769f (close exits 0, no citation moves).
